newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - SCMP started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SCMP started.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it had started coverage of Hong Kong's South China Morning Post (Holdings) Ltd with a rating of underperform.

-- "In aggressively bidding up the shares, the market is contending that SCMP, with recent moves to expand its asset base and into Chinese-language magazine publishing, may have become a growth stock," analyst Kaushik Shridharani wrote in a November 22 report.
-- "We are not impressed by the prospects for expansion into China, or the April acquisition of eight Chinese-language magazines."
-- He said the focus would remain income for shareholders.
-- "We estimate that the fair value for the shares is about HK$6.90 per share, while the maximum level to which they are likely to appreciate over the coming three-year cycle is HK$7.50 per share."
